name: Inter Science Laboratory
headline: Best Laboratory Services in UAE
lede: Interscience is one of the best laboratory services in UAE providing health & safety environmental testing services.
about: Our Environmental, Health & Safety, and Quality management culture is representative of our pursuit for excellence, and is deeply embedded in all aspects of the organisation. Our EHS&Q are supported by a comprehensive suite of accreditations, which demonstrate our competency, and our commitment to delivering the highest level of service to our customers.

Our chemistry testing lab is staffed with highly trained and experienced chemists and lab technicians skilled in providing analysis on a wide variety of material types, including metals, alloys, ceramics, polymers, composites, potable and waste water. Customers rely on ISL to provide reliable, accurate results they can count on.
